svg.aria-label: Muninn over three sessions. Monday: let's use gzip becomes decision 1. Thursday: let's use zstd becomes decision 2 and decision 1 is retired. Two weeks later a new session asks how files are compressed, gets only the zstd decision, and writes zstd.

g.text: A memory that keeps up when you change your mind.
Memory for Claude Code and Codex that puts old decisions away. Runs on your computer.
Same tests, another memory tool: 78% and 10 of 54.
Change of plan, let's use zstd
